episodes.title: What I Would Tell My Cult Member Self #cults #youtubeshorts #advice
episodes.description:
I’m sharing the things I wish someone had told me when I was still inside a high‑control religious environment. At the time, I didn’t have the vocabulary to understand what was happening — I only had the pressure, the fear, and the belief that the group’s demands were “normal.”

If you’re in a group that makes you doubt your own judgment, isolates you from outside relationships, or punishes questions, this video is for you. I’m breaking down the patterns I missed, the tactics I didn’t recognize, and the steps I wish I had taken sooner.

You’re not alone, and you’re not imagining it. 

• BITE Model — Steven Hassan’s framework for Behavior, Information, Thought, and Emotional control.
• Lifton’s Eight Criteria — Robert Jay Lifton’s classic model of thought‑reform environments.
• Coercive Control — A legal/psychological category describing domination through isolation, intimidation, and dependency.
• Undue Influence — A recognized psychological and legal concept describing manipulation that overrides personal autonomy.
• Trauma Bonding — The cycle of harm and “care” that creates emotional attachment to abusive systems.
• Groupthink — Irving Janis’s research on how groups suppress dissent and critical thinking.
